name: status_recap
description: Comprehensive status briefing with time-aware greeting, weather, crypto prices, stock prices, alerts, reminders, and system health. Saves full report to canvas and stash for follow-up questions. Use when user says 'give me a recap', 'status update', 'morning briefing', 'what's happening', or 'daily status'. Default crypto: Bitcoin, Solana. Default stocks: Tesla (TSLA), Gold (GLD). Data is saved to stash so user can ask follow-up questions about the report.

include_news.description: If true, the LLM should use native grounding search to add news headlines to the response

generate_image.description: Generate a visual status image (adds ~60-90 seconds)

stock_symbols.description: Stock/futures symbols: TSLA, AAPL, GC=F (gold), SI=F (silver), CL=F (oil)

sections.description: Sections to include: time, weather, crypto, stocks, alerts, reminders, system
